name: MapColumnValuesNode
label: Map Column Values
description: Replaces values in a column using a lookup dictionary of 'from:to' pairs.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the column to map.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The name of the column whose values will be mapped.

fields.name: Mapping
fields.label: Mapping
fields.description: Comma-separated 'from:to' pairs, e.g., '1:Active,0:Inactive'. Values not found in the mapping are left unchanged.

fields.name: UpdatedDataTable
fields.label: Updated Data Table
fields.description: The data table with the mapped column values.
